mapper.select: SELECT SEM.ID id, SEM.NAME name, SEM.SEQ seq, SEM.CONCENTRATOR_ID concentratorId, SEMC.IP ip, SEMC.PORT port, SEMC.PARK_ID parkId FROM SMT_ELE_METER SEM LEFT JOIN SMT_ELE_METER_CONCENTRATOR SEMC ON SEMC.ID = SEM.CONCENTRATOR_ID WHERE SEM.IS_DELETE = 0 AND SEMC.IP IS NOT NULL
SELECT em.id FROM SMT_ELE_METER em JOIN SMT_ELE_METER_TAG emt ON em.ID = emt.METER_ID JOIN SMT_DEVICE_TAG dt ON emt.TAG_ID = dt.ID WHERE dt.TAG_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{tagName}),'%')

SELECT ELE_METER_ID as id, to_char(Min(COLLECT_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd') as startDate, to_char(Max(COLLECT_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd') as endDate, MIN(CURRENT_READING) as startNum, MAX(CURRENT_READING) as endNum, MAX(CURRENT_READING) - MIN(CURRENT_READING) as sumNum FROM SMT_ELE_METER_HISTORY WHERE COLLECT_TIME BETWEEN to_date( #{startTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' ) AND to_date(#{endTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' )
and ELE_METER_ID in
#{meterId}
GROUP BY ELE_METER_ID, to_char( COLLECT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm' ) ORDER BY to_char( COLLECT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm' ) desc

SELECT WATER_METER_ID as id, to_char(Min(COLLECT_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd') as startDate, to_char(Max(COLLECT_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd') as endDate, MIN(CURRENT_READING) as startNum, MAX(CURRENT_READING) as endNum, MAX(CURRENT_READING) - MIN(CURRENT_READING) as sumNum FROM SMT_WATER_METER_HISTORY WHERE COLLECT_TIME BETWEEN to_date( #{endTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' ) AND to_date(#{endTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss' )
and WATER_METER_ID in
#{meterId}
GROUP BY WATER_METER_ID, to_char( COLLECT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm' ) ORDER BY to_char( COLLECT_TIME, 'yyyy-mm' ) desc
